verdict.rationale: Evidence shows QuickBooks Online supports per-entity CRUD via API/MCP server (29 entity types, 11 reports) and vague mentions of 'syncing data in spreadsheets' for Advanced tier, but nowhere is a genuine bulk/batch operation (e.g., a batch API endpoint or agent tool for acting on many records in one call) documented. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API documentation, MCP tool for multi-item operations, or hands-on evidence of processing many items in a single automated action.
